% UTM team internship report, following the mandatory ELSE Word template.
%
%   1. Fill in the cover fields below.
%   2. Write each part in chapters/; files are numbered in the order they appear.
%   3. Put images in figures/ and include them by name: \includegraphics{my-diagram}.
%   4. Compile from this folder:  tectonic main.tex   (produces main.pdf)
%
% Red text in the PDF comes from \placeholder{...}: replace all of it before submitting.
% `python tools/check.py <this folder>` (from the template repository) lists what is left.
% Do not edit utmreport.cls; it holds the margins, fonts and heading styles.
\documentclass{utmreport}
\selectlanguage{english}

% ---- Cover -----------------------------------------------------------------
\institution{Technical University of Moldova}
\faculty{Faculty of Computers, Informatics, and Microelectronics}
\department{Department of Software Engineering}
\studyprogramme{Software Engineering Study Programme}
\documenttype{Internship report}
\reporttitle{\placeholder{Project title}}
\team{\placeholder{Team No. / Name (if any)}}
%            label       name and surname                 group
\teammember{Student 1}{\placeholder{Name SURNAME}}{\placeholder{FAF-24x}}
\teammember{Student 2}{\placeholder{Name SURNAME}}{\placeholder{FAF-24x}}
\teammember{Student 3}{\placeholder{Name SURNAME}}{\placeholder{FAF-24x}}
\teammember{Student 4}{\placeholder{Name SURNAME}}{\placeholder{FAF-24x}}
\internshipmentor{\placeholder{From internship contract}}
% \submissiondate{12 / 06 / 2026}   % leave commented to print blank dotted fields
\cityyear{Chișinău}{2026}

% PP3702 requires a separate summary chapter for every team member.
% Each call adds its own title-case table-of-contents entry and one summary page.
\newcommand{\UTMInternshipSummaryChapter}[1]{%
  \begingroup
  \titleformat{\chapter}[block]
    {\centering\bfseries\fontsize{13pt}{16pt}\selectfont}{}{0pt}{\MakeUppercase}%
  \UTMUnnumberedChapter*{#1}%
  \endgroup
  \addcontentsline{toc}{chapter}{#1}}
\newcommand{\internshipsummary}[1]{%
  \begingroup
  \def\UTMInternshipSummaryName{#1}%
  \UTMInternshipSummaryChapter{Internship Summary Report\_#1}%
  \input{chapters/11-internship-summary}%
  \endgroup}

\begin{document}
\makeutminternshiptitlepage
\tableofcontents

\input{chapters/01-abstract}
% \input{chapters/02-abbreviations} % required when the report uses abbreviations or English terms
\input{chapters/03-introduction}
\input{chapters/04-chapter-1-domain-analysis}
\input{chapters/05-chapter-2-system-design}
\input{chapters/06-chapter-3-implementation}
\input{chapters/07-conclusions}
\input{chapters/08-references}

\appendix
\input{chapters/09-appendix-a}
\input{chapters/10-appendix-b}

% Add or remove calls with the team list above. Every member needs one summary.
\internshipsummary{\placeholder{Student 1 full name}}
\internshipsummary{\placeholder{Student 2 full name}}
\internshipsummary{\placeholder{Student 3 full name}}
\internshipsummary{\placeholder{Student 4 full name}}
\end{document}
